_explication: Les bruitages du court, générés par ElevenLabs Sound Effects (robot GitHub « Voix », choix « sons »). Description en anglais, durée en secondes (0,5 à 30), boucle pour le fond. Pour refaire un son : le supprimer de app/audio/ (ou le donner dans « ids ») et relancer.

raquette_pierre_01.texte: Clear tennis racket hitting a tennis ball, soft round pop with a short whoosh of the racket, single hit, close-up, no crowd

raquette_pierre_fort_01.texte: Fast slicing tennis shot, sharp whoosh and pop with stadium reverb, no crowd

raquette_ciseaux_01.texte: Loud tennis ball hit mixed with a sharp metallic scissors snip, single short hit, close-up, no crowd

raquette_ciseaux_fort_01.texte: Powerful loud tennis smash mixed with a big sharp metallic scissors snip, stadium reverb, single hit, no crowd

raquette_feuille_01.texte: Heavy tennis ball hit, deep powerful thud, low pitch, close-up, no crowd

raquette_feuille_fort_01.texte: Massive tennis smash, very powerful deep thud with stadium reverb, no crowd

public_fond_01.texte: Tennis stadium crowd ambience, quiet murmurs, soft whispers, calm, seamless loop

public_tension_01.texte: Tennis crowd murmuring nervously, rising tension, buzzing anticipation

public_ooh_01.texte: Tennis crowd "ooh" reaction to a near miss

public_clameur_01.texte: Tennis crowd cheering burst after a great point

public_set_01.texte: Warm tennis crowd applause with a few cheers

public_ovation_01.texte: Standing ovation in a tennis stadium, loud cheers and whistles
